nodes.name: Message Queue System.md
nodes.filePath: .qoder/repowiki/en/content/Core Features/Communication System/Message Queue System/Message Queue System.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki documentation covering SETURA's dual notification and job queue system for WhatsApp messaging, reminder scheduling, and background job processing, with priority handling, exponential backoff retries, dead-letter handling, and monitoring.

nodes.id: document:.qoder/repowiki/en/content/Core Features/Communication System/Message Queue System/Queue Architecture.md
nodes.name: Queue Architecture.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki documentation describing the notification queue architecture, including schema, priority ordering, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED concurrent processing, exponential backoff retries, dead-letter handling, partitioning strategy, and monitoring metrics.

nodes.id: document:.qoder/repowiki/en/content/Core Features/Communication System/Message Queue System/Reminder Scheduling.md
nodes.name: Reminder Scheduling.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki documentation explaining the automated appointment reminder scheduling system, including trigger logic based on hospital business rules, time-window calculations, template-driven content, delivery tracking, and integration with the booking engine.
